name: KaBuM!
description: Brazilian online store for technology and gaming. Sells hardware, memory, gaming PCs, computers, peripherals and TVs, and offers a build-your-own-PC service. Its homepage quotes delivery by postal code and links a marketplace section for partner sellers; the delivery area is not stated on the homepage.
description_es: Tienda online brasileña de tecnología y gaming. Vende hardware, memoria, PC gamer, computadoras, periféricos y TV, y ofrece un servicio para armar la PC. Su página principal calcula la entrega por código postal y enlaza una sección de marketplace para vendedores asociados; el área de entrega no figura en la página principal.

ships_to.notes: Homepage quotes delivery by postal code (CEP) but states no coverage area. Site policies say delivery time and freight vary by stock location and some products may be unavailable for some localities.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Site policies mention a pickup modality that is not available for all products or addresses.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Prices in BRL. Shipping quoted by CEP. Some products are sold by marketplace partner sellers with their own shipping policies. Search results render with JavaScript.

sources.supports: product range, CEP shipping field, marketplace link
delivery time and freight vary by location, pickup modality, marketplace sellers
